contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #323: Independence of the separable quotient problem.

Prescribed-weight estimate in the staged September 23, 2026 manuscript, under its actual family, parameter, block-window and thinning hypotheses. No CH counterexample or upstream weak-Cauchy theorem is assumed proved by this local audit.

definitions.operations: Pure Type I/II operations in K_k; mixed Type I/II operations in K, with earlier-stage children, original uncropped path coding, ordinal or rectangle crops, and pairwise disjoint active weights at each expression.
definitions.blocks: L=L_J successive finite blocks in one pure color, or successive in both ordinal and color orders, with norm at most 2, interval partition constant A=16 for d<=L_{J_i}, ordered windows J_i>J and J_{i+1}>T_i, and l1-coordinate tail <=epsilon.
definitions.thinning: For each e<L, every actual uncropped path has at most three hits after e at threshold delta_{e+1}; T_e delta_{e+1}<=epsilon*2^(-e); epsilon L^(1/r)<=theta_J.
definitions.parameters: 1<q<r=sprime; theta_j=L_j^(1/r)/m_j; c0=sum theta_j<1/8; tail theta<=4 theta_J; B_J=2 sum_{j<J} L_j; 8^(-d_J)<=theta_J; (1+B_J)^d_J*(1+B_J+L_J^(1/qprime))<=L_J/m_J.

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 323 (Independence of the separable quotient problem.; papers: Relative independence of the separable quotient problem; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/323.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

For every finite valid expression f in the relevant pure K_k or mixed K and every block family satisfying the stated window and thinning hypotheses, sum_{i=1}^{L_J}|f(x_i)| <= (2112/7)*L_J/m_J, independently of construction depth.

Every actual Type I/II expression with arbitrary assigned block subsets admits the high/window/low decomposition; window paths have at most eight marked assigned indices, the window columns have qprime norm at most 2, boundary incidences sum to at most 2L_j, and singleton assignments are disjoint within each weight group, including rectangle crops and mixed pure terminals.

A finite grouped recursion with support-preserving descendants, disjoint supports within each group and possible overlap across groups obeys the sum-of-group-lr contraction and the geometric small-charge plus finite-node-count large-charge bound at every cutoff depth.
Every infinite admissible block sequence in any prescribed tail has L_J blocks satisfying all window and thinning hypotheses of the estimate.

Manuscript Lemma pair:partition: for every N and every infinite admissible block sequence there is a finite unit block u in any prescribed tail with sum_b ||P_{I_b}u||<=8 d^(1/r) for every d<=N and every successive ordinal interval family.

Manuscript Proposition path:weak-cauchy: every bounded block sequence in a fixed pure or mixed family has a weak-Cauchy subsequence. This upstream analytic claim remains open in the selected estimate mission.

Manuscript Lemma pair:four-hits: from a weakly null admissible block sequence satisfying the coherence, partition and tail conditions, every infinite index set has an infinite subset on which no actual finite uncropped path has four hits at any fixed positive threshold.

Conditional on C_CH_WINDOWS and the local norm/crop properties, C_CH_EST gives Proposition pair:exact: in every prescribed tail and at every J, a block y and supported same-family Type I functional phi of weight J satisfy ||y||<=500 and phi(y)>=1/2.

Manuscript intro:main(ii) and twist:counterexample: CH implies a real (and then complex) infinite-dimensional Banach space with no separable infinite-dimensional quotient. Beyond the selected prescribed-weight estimate, upstream weak-Cauchy, subspace reduction, branch separation, and predual twist proofs remain unaudited.
Manuscript intro:main(i): a real-valued measurable continuum implies the real and complex separable quotient assertions. This is outside the selected estimate mission and remains open here.

Conditional on C_CH_WINDOWS and the local norm/crop properties, C_CH_EST gives Proposition pair:exact: in every prescribed tail and at every J, a block y and supported same-family Type I functional phi of weight J satisfy ||y||<=500 and phi(y)>=1/2.

external_assumptions.statement: The manuscript window construction is valid in arbitrary admissible block subspaces; this includes the as-yet unaudited weak-Cauchy subsequence theorem and the partition and four-hit lemmas.
external_assumptions.source: Staged manuscript, build/sections/exact-pairs.tex pair:partition and pair:four-hits; build/sections/paths.tex path:weak-cauchy; treated as an explicit unresolved analytic prerequisite, not a proved external theorem.

claims.natural_statement: For every finite real coordinate space and every finite exponent p>=1, sums of vectors whose nonzero supports are pairwise disjoint within each group have the exact power-sum identity; weighted recombination has norm at most K times the sum of coefficient times group-cardinality^(1/p), without any disjointness across groups. The scalar cutoff recurrence has its geometric upper bound at every natural depth, and the complete b-ary charge tree has at most (1+b)^d nodes above depth d. These are formal core lemmas, not a formalization of the manuscript norming grammar or upstream window-existence theorem.

For all finite real coordinate spaces and finite exponents p>=1, disjoint-within-group weighted recombination obeys the exact power-sum identity and lp contraction, with arbitrary cross-group overlaps; support is preserved on parent assignments. For arbitrary coherently ordered attributes, a product-convex crop contains every block between two hits and has at most two partial hits. For every natural cutoff depth the geometric recurrence and complete b-ary charge-tree bounds hold, with exact budget constants 130/7, 1682/7 and 1794/7. This formal core does not encode the entire manuscript norming grammar or upstream window existence.

import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Lp.PiLp
import Mathlib.Tactic

open scoped BigOperators ENNReal

namespace ExactPair

variable {ι H G : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype H] [Fintype G]

theorem power_sum_at_most_one (f : H → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (hdis : ∀ h k, h ≠ k → f h = 0 ∨ f k = 0) :
    |∑ h, f h| ^ r = ∑ h, |f h| ^ r := by
  classical
  by_cases hz : ∀ h, f h = 0
  · simp [hz, Real.zero_rpow hr]
  · obtain ⟨h₀, hh₀⟩ := not_forall.mp hz
    have hother : ∀ h, h ≠ h₀ → f h = 0 := by
      intro h hh
      rcases hdis h h₀ hh with hzero | hzero
      · exact hzero
      · exact False.elim (hh₀ hzero)
    rw [Fintype.sum_eq_single h₀ (fun h hh => hother h hh),
      Fintype.sum_eq_single h₀ (fun h hh => by
        simp [hother h hh, Real.zero_rpow hr])]

abbrev Vec (p : ℝ≥0∞) (ι : Type*) := PiLp p (fun _ : ι => ℝ)

variable {p : ℝ≥0∞} [Fact (1 ≤ p)]

theorem exponent_pos (hp : p ≠ ∞) : 0 < p.toReal := by
  apply ENNReal.toReal_pos_iff.mpr
  constructor
  · exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ≥0∞) < 1) (Fact.out : 1 ≤ p)
  · exact lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr hp

omit [Fintype ι] [Fact (1 ≤ p)] in
theorem sum_apply (w : H → Vec p ι) (i : ι) :
    (∑ h, w h) i = ∑ h, w h i := by
  change (WithLp.ofLp (∑ h, w h)) i = _
  simp only [WithLp.ofLp_sum, Finset.sum_apply]

theorem norm_power (hp : p ≠ ∞) (w : Vec p ι) :
    ‖w‖ ^ p.toReal = ∑ i, ‖w i‖ ^ p.toReal := by
  have hr := exponent_pos hp
  rw [PiLp.norm_eq_sum hr, ← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity)]
  simp [one_div, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne']

theorem disjoint_sum_norm (hp : p ≠ ∞) (w : H → Vec p ι)
    (hdis : ∀ i h k, h ≠ k → w h i = 0 ∨ w k i = 0) :
    ‖∑ h, w h‖ = (∑ h, ‖w h‖ ^ p.toReal) ^ (1 / p.toReal) := by
  have hr := exponent_pos hp
  rw [PiLp.norm_eq_sum hr]
  congr 1
  calc
    (∑ i, ‖(∑ h, w h) i‖ ^ p.toReal) =
        ∑ i, ∑ h, ‖w h i‖ ^ p.toReal := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      simp only [sum_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact power_sum_at_most_one _ _ hr.ne' (hdis i)
    _ = ∑ h, ∑ i, ‖w h i‖ ^ p.toReal := Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ h, ‖w h‖ ^ p.toReal := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro h _
      exact (norm_power hp (w h)).symm

theorem disjoint_sum_bound (hp : p ≠ ∞) (w : H → Vec p ι)
    (hdis : ∀ i h k, h ≠ k → w h i = 0 ∨ w k i = 0)
    (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hw : ∀ h, ‖w h‖ ≤ K) :
    ‖∑ h, w h‖ ≤ (Fintype.card H : ℝ) ^ (1 / p.toReal) * K := by
  have hr := exponent_pos hp
  rw [disjoint_sum_norm hp w hdis]
  calc
    (∑ h, ‖w h‖ ^ p.toReal) ^ (1 / p.toReal) ≤
        (∑ _h : H, K ^ p.toReal) ^ (1 / p.toReal) := by
      apply Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity)
      · exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun h _ =>
          Real.rpow_le_rpow (norm_nonneg _) (hw h) hr.le)
      · positivity
    _ = ((Fintype.card H : ℝ) * K ^ p.toReal) ^ (1 / p.toReal) := by simp
    _ = (Fintype.card H : ℝ) ^ (1 / p.toReal) * K := by
      rw [Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) (Real.rpow_nonneg hK _),
        ← Real.rpow_mul hK]
      simp [one_div, mul_inv_cancel₀ hr.ne']

theorem grouped_bound {H : G → Type*} [∀ g, Fintype (H g)]
    (hp : p ≠ ∞) (w : (g : G) → H g → Vec p ι)
    (hdis : ∀ g i h k, h ≠ k → w g h i = 0 ∨ w g k i = 0)
    (a : G → ℝ) (ha : ∀ g, 0 ≤ a g)
    (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hw : ∀ g h, ‖w g h‖ ≤ K) :
    ‖∑ g, a g • ∑ h, w g h‖ ≤
      K * ∑ g, a g * (Fintype.card (H g) : ℝ) ^ (1 / p.toReal) := by
  calc
    ‖∑ g, a g • ∑ h, w g h‖ ≤ ∑ g, ‖a g • ∑ h, w g h‖ :=
      norm_sum_le _ _
    _ = ∑ g, a g * ‖∑ h, w g h‖ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro g _
      simp [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (ha g)]
    _ ≤ ∑ g, a g * ((Fintype.card (H g) : ℝ) ^ (1 / p.toReal) * K) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro g _
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (disjoint_sum_bound hp (w g) (hdis g) K hK (hw g)) (ha g)
    _ = K * ∑ g, a g * (Fintype.card (H g) : ℝ) ^ (1 / p.toReal) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro g _
      ring

omit [Fintype ι] [Fintype H] [Fact (1 ≤ p)] in
theorem assignments_give_disjointness (S : H → Finset ι)
    (hS : ∀ h k, h ≠ k → Disjoint (S h) (S k))
    (w : H → Vec p ι) (hw : ∀ h i, i ∉ S h → w h i = 0) :
    ∀ i h k, h ≠ k → w h i = 0 ∨ w k i = 0 := by
  intro i h k hne
  by_cases hi : i ∈ S h
  · right
    apply hw k i
    intro hik
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hS h k hne) hi hik
  · exact Or.inl (hw h i hi)

omit [Fintype ι] [Fact (1 ≤ p)] in
theorem supported_recombine {H : G → Type*} [∀ g, Fintype (H g)]
    (S : Finset ι) (T : (g : G) → H g → Finset ι)
    (hsub : ∀ g h, T g h ⊆ S)
    (w : (g : G) → H g → Vec p ι)
    (hw : ∀ g h i, i ∉ T g h → w g h i = 0) (a : G → ℝ) :
    ∀ i, i ∉ S → (∑ g, a g • ∑ h, w g h) i = 0 := by
  intro i hi
  have hz : ∀ g h, w g h i = 0 := by
    intro g h
    apply hw g h i
    exact fun hit => hi (hsub g h hit)
  simp only [sum_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  simp [hz]

theorem product_crop_between {β Ω κ : Type*} [LinearOrder β]
    {D : κ → Type*} [∀ t, LinearOrder (D t)]
    (S : β → Set Ω) (coord : (t : κ) → Ω → D t) (C : (t : κ) → Set (D t))
    (hconv : ∀ t (a b c : D t), a ∈ C t → c ∈ C t → a ≤ b → b ≤ c → b ∈ C t)
    (hsucc : ∀ i j, i < j → ∀ a ∈ S i, ∀ b ∈ S j,
      ∀ t, coord t a < coord t b)
    {i j k : β} (hij : i < j) (hjk : j < k)
    (hi : ∃ a ∈ S i, ∀ t, coord t a ∈ C t)
    (hk : ∃ c ∈ S k, ∀ t, coord t c ∈ C t) :
    ∀ b ∈ S j, ∀ t, coord t b ∈ C t := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, haC⟩ := hi
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hcC⟩ := hk
  intro b hb t
  exact hconv t _ _ _ (haC t) (hcC t)
    (hsucc i j hij a ha b hb t).le (hsucc j k hjk b hb c hc t).le

theorem at_most_two_partial {β : Type*} [LinearOrder β]
    (hits edgeHits : Finset β) (hsub : edgeHits ⊆ hits)
    (hbetween : ∀ a ∈ hits, ∀ b ∈ edgeHits, ∀ c ∈ hits, a < b → b < c → False) :
    edgeHits.card ≤ 2 := by
  classical
  rcases hits.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hempty | hne
  · have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    rw [hempty, Finset.card_empty] at hcard
    omega
  · have hends : edgeHits ⊆ {hits.min' hne, hits.max' hne} := by
      intro b hb
      by_cases hmin : b = hits.min' hne
      · simp [hmin]
      by_cases hmax : b = hits.max' hne
      · simp [hmax]
      exact False.elim (hbetween _ (hits.min'_mem hne) b hb _ (hits.max'_mem hne)
        (lt_of_le_of_ne (hits.min'_le b (hsub hb)) (Ne.symm hmin))
        (lt_of_le_of_ne (hits.le_max' b (hsub hb)) hmax))
    exact (Finset.card_le_card hends).trans Finset.card_le_two

def smallBudget (c σ K : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => K
  | d + 1 => σ + c * smallBudget c σ K d

theorem smallBudget_le (c σ K : ℝ) (hc₀ : 0 ≤ c) (hc₁ : c < 1)
    (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (d : ℕ) :
    smallBudget c σ K d ≤ σ / (1 - c) + c ^ d * K := by
  have hden : 0 < 1 - c := by linarith
  induction d with
  | zero =>
      simp only [smallBudget, pow_zero, one_mul]
      linarith [div_nonneg hσ hden.le]
  | succ d ih =>
      calc
        smallBudget c σ K (d + 1) ≤
            σ + c * (σ / (1 - c) + c ^ d * K) := by
          change σ + c * smallBudget c σ K d ≤ _
          exact add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih hc₀)
        _ = σ / (1 - c) + c ^ (d + 1) * K := by
          rw [pow_succ]
          field_simp
          ring

def chargeNodes (b : ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ
  | 0 => 0
  | d + 1 => 1 + b * chargeNodes b d

theorem chargeNodes_le (b d : ℕ) : chargeNodes b d ≤ (1 + b) ^ d := by
  induction d with
  | zero => simp [chargeNodes]
  | succ d ih =>
      have hpos : 0 < (1 + b) ^ d := pow_pos (by omega) _
      have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_left b ih
      simp only [chargeNodes, pow_succ]
      nlinarith

theorem uniform_budget_closed (c e : ℝ) (hc : c ≤ 1 / 8) (he : e ≤ c) :
    12 + 2 * e + 32 * c + c * (130 / 7) ≤ (130 / 7 : ℝ) := by
  linarith

theorem manuscript_small_budget (c θ : ℝ) (d : ℕ)
    (hc₀ : 0 ≤ c) (hc₁ : c ≤ 1 / 8) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (hd : c ^ d ≤ θ) :
    smallBudget c (194 * θ) (130 / 7) d ≤ (1682 / 7 : ℝ) * θ := by
  have hc : c < 1 := by linarith
  have hden : 0 < 1 - c := by linarith
  have hdiv : 194 * θ / (1 - c) ≤ (1552 / 7 : ℝ) * θ := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hden).mpr
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc₁ hθ
    nlinarith
  have hres := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 130 / 7)
  have hsmall := smallBudget_le c (194 * θ) (130 / 7) hc₀ hc (by positivity) d
  nlinarith

theorem final_constant (θ small other : ℝ)
    (hs : small ≤ (1682 / 7 : ℝ) * θ) (ho : other ≤ 16 * θ) :
    small + other ≤ (1794 / 7 : ℝ) * θ := by
  linarith

end ExactPair

claims.natural_statement: For any collection of linearly ordered attributes and supports strictly successive in every attribute in the same index order, a product of convex crops meeting two blocks contains every intervening block. Thus at most two met blocks are partially cropped, independently of crop dimension. In the actual pure and mixed expressions this improves the per-path marking count to six.

For every actual finite pure K_k or mixed K norming expression, all construction depths, and every block family satisfying the manuscript parameter, window and uncropped-path thinning hypotheses, sum_i |f(x_i)| <= (1794/7)*L_J/m_J. The proof uses the dimension-free two-boundary crop lemma, arbitrary assigned subsets, and no disjointness between different weight groups.

For all finite real coordinate spaces and finite exponents p>=1, disjoint-within-group weighted recombination obeys the exact power-sum identity and lp contraction, with arbitrary cross-group overlaps; support is preserved on parent assignments. For arbitrary coherently ordered attributes, a product-convex crop contains every block between two hits and has at most two partial hits. For every natural cutoff depth the geometric recurrence and complete b-ary charge-tree bounds hold, with exact budget constants 130/7, 1682/7 and 1794/7. This formal core does not encode the entire manuscript norming grammar or upstream window existence.

omit [Fintype ι] [Fintype H] [Fact (1 ≤ p)] in
theorem assignments_give_disjointness (S : H → Finset ι)
    (hS : ∀ h k, h ≠ k → Disjoint (S h) (S k))
    (w : H → Vec p ι) (hw : ∀ h i, i ∉ S h → w h i = 0) :
    ∀ i h k, h ≠ k → w h i = 0 ∨ w k i = 0 := by
  intro i h k hne
  by_cases hi : i ∈ S h
  · right
    apply hw k i
    intro hik
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hS h k hne) hi hik
  · exact Or.inl (hw h i hi)

omit [Fintype ι] [Fact (1 ≤ p)] in
theorem supported_recombine {H : G → Type*} [∀ g, Fintype (H g)]
    (S : Finset ι) (T : (g : G) → H g → Finset ι)
    (hsub : ∀ g h, T g h ⊆ S)
    (w : (g : G) → H g → Vec p ι)
    (hw : ∀ g h i, i ∉ T g h → w g h i = 0) (a : G → ℝ) :
    ∀ i, i ∉ S → (∑ g, a g • ∑ h, w g h) i = 0 := by
  intro i hi
  have hz : ∀ g h, w g h i = 0 := by
    intro g h
    apply hw g h i
    exact fun hit => hi (hsub g h hit)
  simp only [sum_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  simp [hz]

theorem product_crop_between {β Ω κ : Type*} [LinearOrder β]
    {D : κ → Type*} [∀ t, LinearOrder (D t)]
    (S : β → Set Ω) (coord : (t : κ) → Ω → D t) (C : (t : κ) → Set (D t))
    (hconv : ∀ t (a b c : D t), a ∈ C t → c ∈ C t → a ≤ b → b ≤ c → b ∈ C t)
    (hsucc : ∀ i j, i < j → ∀ a ∈ S i, ∀ b ∈ S j,
      ∀ t, coord t a < coord t b)
    {i j k : β} (hij : i < j) (hjk : j < k)
    (hi : ∃ a ∈ S i, ∀ t, coord t a ∈ C t)
    (hk : ∃ c ∈ S k, ∀ t, coord t c ∈ C t) :
    ∀ b ∈ S j, ∀ t, coord t b ∈ C t := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, haC⟩ := hi
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hcC⟩ := hk
  intro b hb t
  exact hconv t _ _ _ (haC t) (hcC t)
    (hsucc i j hij a ha b hb t).le (hsucc j k hjk b hb c hc t).le

theorem at_most_two_partial {β : Type*} [LinearOrder β]
    (hits edgeHits : Finset β) (hsub : edgeHits ⊆ hits)
    (hbetween : ∀ a ∈ hits, ∀ b ∈ edgeHits, ∀ c ∈ hits, a < b → b < c → False) :
    edgeHits.card ≤ 2 := by
  classical
  rcases hits.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hempty | hne
  · have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    rw [hempty, Finset.card_empty] at hcard
    omega
  · have hends : edgeHits ⊆ {hits.min' hne, hits.max' hne} := by
      intro b hb
      by_cases hmin : b = hits.min' hne
      · simp [hmin]
      by_cases hmax : b = hits.max' hne
      · simp [hmax]
      exact False.elim (hbetween _ (hits.min'_mem hne) b hb _ (hits.max'_mem hne)
        (lt_of_le_of_ne (hits.min'_le b (hsub hb)) (Ne.symm hmin))
        (lt_of_le_of_ne (hits.le_max' b (hsub hb)) hmax))
    exact (Finset.card_le_card hends).trans Finset.card_le_two

open scoped Classical in
theorem product_crop_partial_bound {β Ω κ : Type*} [LinearOrder β]
    {D : κ → Type*} [∀ t, LinearOrder (D t)]
    (S : β → Set Ω) (coord : (t : κ) → Ω → D t) (C : (t : κ) → Set (D t))
    (hconv : ∀ t (a b c : D t), a ∈ C t → c ∈ C t → a ≤ b → b ≤ c → b ∈ C t)
    (hsucc : ∀ i j, i < j → ∀ a ∈ S i, ∀ b ∈ S j,
      ∀ t, coord t a < coord t b)
    (indices : Finset β) :
    (indices.filter (fun i =>
      (∃ a ∈ S i, ∀ t, coord t a ∈ C t) ∧
      ¬ (∀ b ∈ S i, ∀ t, coord t b ∈ C t))).card ≤ 2 := by
  classical
  let hits := indices.filter (fun i => ∃ a ∈ S i, ∀ t, coord t a ∈ C t)
  apply at_most_two_partial hits
  · intro i hi
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr
      ⟨(Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).1, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2.1⟩
  · intro a ha b hb c hc hab hbc
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).2.2
      (product_crop_between S coord C hconv hsucc hab hbc
        (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hc).2)

def smallBudget (c σ K : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => K
  | d + 1 => σ + c * smallBudget c σ K d

theorem smallBudget_le (c σ K : ℝ) (hc₀ : 0 ≤ c) (hc₁ : c < 1)
    (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (d : ℕ) :
    smallBudget c σ K d ≤ σ / (1 - c) + c ^ d * K := by
  have hden : 0 < 1 - c := by linarith
  induction d with
  | zero =>
      simp only [smallBudget, pow_zero, one_mul]
      linarith [div_nonneg hσ hden.le]
  | succ d ih =>
      calc
        smallBudget c σ K (d + 1) ≤
            σ + c * (σ / (1 - c) + c ^ d * K) := by
          change σ + c * smallBudget c σ K d ≤ _
          exact add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih hc₀)
        _ = σ / (1 - c) + c ^ (d + 1) * K := by
          rw [pow_succ]
          field_simp
          ring

def chargeNodes (b : ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ
  | 0 => 0
  | d + 1 => 1 + b * chargeNodes b d

theorem chargeNodes_le (b d : ℕ) : chargeNodes b d ≤ (1 + b) ^ d := by
  induction d with
  | zero => simp [chargeNodes]
  | succ d ih =>
      have hpos : 0 < (1 + b) ^ d := pow_pos (by omega) _
      have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_left b ih
      simp only [chargeNodes, pow_succ]
      nlinarith

theorem uniform_budget_closed (c e : ℝ) (hc : c ≤ 1 / 8) (he : e ≤ c) :
    12 + 2 * e + 32 * c + c * (130 / 7) ≤ (130 / 7 : ℝ) := by
  linarith

theorem manuscript_small_budget (c θ : ℝ) (d : ℕ)
    (hc₀ : 0 ≤ c) (hc₁ : c ≤ 1 / 8) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (hd : c ^ d ≤ θ) :
    smallBudget c (194 * θ) (130 / 7) d ≤ (1682 / 7 : ℝ) * θ := by
  have hc : c < 1 := by linarith
  have hden : 0 < 1 - c := by linarith
  have hdiv : 194 * θ / (1 - c) ≤ (1552 / 7 : ℝ) * θ := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hden).mpr
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc₁ hθ
    nlinarith
  have hres := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 130 / 7)
  have hsmall := smallBudget_le c (194 * θ) (130 / 7) hc₀ hc (by positivity) d
  nlinarith

theorem final_constant (θ small other : ℝ)
    (hs : small ≤ (1682 / 7 : ℝ) * θ) (ho : other ≤ 16 * θ) :
    small + other ≤ (1794 / 7 : ℝ) * θ := by
  linarith
